name: Stonehenge, Avebury and Associated Sites
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: On Salisbury Plain in Wiltshire, England, Stonehenge rises as a ring of huge standing stones, each about 4 metres tall and capped with lintels locked in place by carved joints. Built in phases from around 3100 BC, it lines up with the solstice sun. Nearby, the vast stone circles of Avebury and hundreds of burial mounds fill a landscape of prehistoric monuments.
